name: VeloSpot
tagline: Find and navigate to bike parking spots nearby
description:
VeloSpot helps you find and navigate to bike parking spots across Germany, France, and Luxembourg, with more than 100,000 locations in its database. It works offline-first, so you can find a place to lock up your bike even without a solid data connection.

It's built on open data and open-source routing, giving cyclists a genuinely free alternative to searching around blindly for somewhere safe to park.
